name: Bound to Place — Tag
notes: The being's nature and power are tied to a specific natural seat.

name: Bound to Place — Trait
traitDescription: It is tied to a natural seat such as a grove, spring, stone, marsh, or cliff, and is strongest when acting through or within that place.
notes: Core identity trait for Nature Spirits.

name: Warden of a Natural Seat — Tag
notes: Reacts to trespass, damage, theft, pollution, and broken respect within its place.

name: Warden of a Natural Seat — Trait
traitDescription: It notices and reacts when its place is violated, neglected, polluted, despoiled, or treated without proper respect, and may answer respect with aid or trespass with warning, misdirection, or death.
notes: Core reciprocity and guardianship rule for Nature Spirits.

name: More Than Landscape — Tag
notes: The being is part of the place, but not merely scenery.

name: More Than Landscape — Trait
traitDescription: It can seem beautiful, monstrous, half-seen, or wholly natural until it chooses to reveal that the place itself is watching.
notes: Tone-setting trait for local uncanny presence.

name: Grant: Call of the Place
notes: Grants the Call of the Place power.

name: Grant: Grasp of Root and Stone
notes: Grants the Grasp of Root and Stone power.

name: Grant: Slip Into the Land
notes: Grants the Slip Into the Land power.

name: Grant: Blessing of the Place
notes: Grants the (optional) Blessing of the Place power.

name: Natural Creature — Tag
notes: The being is a natural animal, not an inherently supernatural entity.

name: Natural Creature — Trait
traitDescription: This is a living animal shaped by body, instinct, and environment rather than by glamour, curse, or mythic office.
notes: Core identity trait for Beasts.

name: Keen Senses — Tag
notes: The animal notices scent, sound, movement, and weakness quickly.

name: Keen Senses — Trait
traitDescription: It relies on scent, hearing, movement, and instinctive awareness to track danger, prey, or intrusion.
notes: Core perception and pursuit trait for Beasts.

name: Tooth and Claw — Tag
notes: The creature's body is itself a weapon.

name: Tooth and Claw — Trait
traitDescription: It attacks with bite, claw, horn, tusk, trampling force, or other natural weaponry rather than crafted arms.
notes: Core attack-shape trait for Beasts.

name: Grant: Savage Rush
notes: Grants the Savage Rush power.

name: Grant: Maul
notes: Grants the Maul power.

name: Grant: Break Away
notes: Grants the Break Away power.

name: Half-Seen — Tag
notes: Hidden Folk are difficult to clearly perceive.

name: Half-Seen — Trait
traitDescription: The being is difficult to clearly make out because it dwells partly in hidden parallel to ordinary human sight, revealing itself only by choice, pressure, or failure of concealment.
notes: Paired with the Glamour tag.

name: Bound to Custom — Tag
notes: Hidden Folk react to trespass and broken custom.

name: Bound to Custom — Trait
traitDescription: It reacts strongly to trespass, insult, theft, broken hospitality, oath-breaking, and other violations of the older rules by which its people deal with the world.
notes: Core folklore-law rule for Hidden Folk.

name: Elder Parallel People — Trait
traitDescription: It belongs to an older hidden people that still occupies the land beside humanity, with pride, memory, and purposes that do not center human needs.
notes: Tone-setting trait for Hidden Folk as a parallel elder nation rather than a mere local oddity.

name: Grant: Brush of Glamour
notes: Grants the Brush of Glamour power.

name: Grant: Cold Hand
notes: Grants the Cold Hand power.

name: Grant: Slip Aside
notes: Grants the Slip Aside power.

name: Unpassed Dead — Tag
notes: The being is dead, or should be dead, and yet remains active in the world.

name: Unpassed Dead — Trait
traitDescription: It did not pass properly out of the world. Whether corpse, spirit, echo, or false continuation, it remains because death was denied, disrupted, or refused.
notes: Core identity trait for Undead.

name: Bound by the Cause of Return — Tag
notes: The being remains tied to a cause, grievance, pact, rite, impurity, or unfinished purpose.

name: Bound by the Cause of Return — Trait
traitName: Bound by the Cause of Return
traitDescription: Its continued presence is anchored in hatred, grief, injustice, oath, wrong burial, unclean spirit, magic, or some other unresolved cause that gives shape to its return.
notes: Core motive and anchor trait for Undead.

name: Grave Wrongness — Tag
notes: The being carries the pressure of death not being at rest.

name: Grave Wrongness — Trait
traitDescription: Its presence brings dread, chill, sorrow, sacrilege, corruption, or the sense that something about death has gone uncleanly wrong.
notes: Core emotional and spiritual pressure trait for Undead.

name: Grant: Return Unbidden
notes: Grants the Return Unbidden power.

name: Grant: Touch of the Grave
notes: Grants the Touch of the Grave power.

name: Grant: Presence of the Unquiet
notes: Grants the Presence of the Unquiet power.

name: Twisted From Rightful Shape — Tag
notes: The being has been altered from its proper form or condition.

name: Twisted From Rightful Shape — Trait
traitDescription: It bears a condition forced by curse, corruption, punishment, or magical distortion rather than by ordinary nature.
notes: Core identity trait for Cursed beings.

name: Instability of Form or Will — Tag
notes: The being is marked by visible wrongness, volatility, or pressure on mind and body.

name: Instability of Form or Will — Trait
traitDescription: Its body, appetite, senses, or judgment may be unstable, overdriven, or bent toward an imposed condition that is difficult to master.
notes: Core volatility trait for Cursed beings.

name: Carries the Curse Forward — Tag
notes: Contact with the being may spread, deepen, or awaken harmful transformation.

name: Carries the Curse Forward — Trait
traitDescription: Harm, gaze, blood, bite, venom, or proximity to the creature may transmit its condition, worsen an existing taint, or impose a lesser version of its corruption.
notes: Core transmission and consequence trait for Cursed beings.

name: Grant: Violent Transformation
notes: Grants the Violent Transformation power.

name: Grant: Curse-Borne Attack
notes: Grants the Curse-Borne Attack power.

name: Grant: Curse Pressure
notes: Grants the Curse Pressure power.

name: Of Higher Order — Tag
notes: The being stands above ordinary Hidden Folk in power, age, and significance.

name: Of Higher Order — Trait
traitDescription: This is not an ordinary hidden creature but one of the elder great beings of the parallel civilization, set apart by age, magical force, and consequence.
notes: Core status trait for old-god-like powers among the Hidden Folk world.

name: Majesty or Dread — Tag
notes: Mortals are unsettled merely by being near the being.

name: Majesty or Dread — Trait
traitDescription: Mortals and lesser Hidden Folk alike feel awe, fascination, pressure, or terror in its presence even when it is calm.
notes: Core emotional pressure aura for the Unseen.

name: Bound by Ancient Law — Tag
notes: The being is powerful through and constrained by old law.

name: Bound by Ancient Law — Trait
traitDescription: Bargains, names, invitations, thresholds, oaths, and older hidden obligations carry real force when dealing with it.
notes: Core folklore-law rule for powerful singular beings.

name: Not Meant for Common Company — Tag
notes: Concealment and ordinary obscurity are less effective before the being.

name: Not Meant for Common Company — Trait
traitDescription: Prolonged contact with the being disturbs mortal judgment, fortune, sleep, piety, or allegiance, and concealment is less reliable before it.
notes: Combines old-god-like presence with superior supernatural perception.

name: Grant: Sovereign Presence
notes: Grants the Sovereign Presence power.

name: Grant: Word of Binding
notes: Grants the Word of Binding power.

name: Grant: Pass Unbarred
notes: Grants the Pass Unbarred power.

name: Grant: Bestow or Withhold
notes: Grants the (optional) Bestow or Withhold power.

name: Summoned Outsider — Tag
notes: The being does not properly belong to the world and has entered it from elsewhere.

name: Summoned Outsider — Trait
traitDescription: It is not merely strange, foreign, or magical, but a being from another existence brought or loosed into the world by summoning, breach, invitation, or unlawful passage.
notes: Core origin trait for Unnaturals.

name: Factional Pressure — Tag
notes: Contact with the being puts pressure on conscience, desire, allegiance, fear, or faith.

name: Factional Pressure — Trait
traitDescription: Its presence brings temptation, dread, zeal, condemnation, or spiritual pressure because every encounter with it is entangled in a larger factional struggle for souls, service, and allegiance.
notes: Core emotional and spiritual pressure trait for Unnaturals as war agents rather than isolated beings.

name: Bound to Hierarchy — Tag
notes: The being acts according to hierarchy, doctrine, command, hunger, law, or factional purpose.

name: Bound to Hierarchy — Trait
traitDescription: It is not merely capricious. Even when seductive, merciful, or destructive, it acts under a factional order of rank, doctrine, command, or appetite that reaches beyond the mortal world.
notes: Core hierarchy trait for Unnaturals.

name: Grant: Presence of the Outer War
notes: Grants the Presence of the Outer War power.

name: Grant: Word of Temptation or Command
notes: Grants the Word of Temptation or Command power.

name: Grant: Enter Unbidden
notes: Grants the Enter Unbidden power.

name: Made Thing — Tag
notes: The being is crafted, assembled, or shaped into existence rather than naturally born.

name: Made Thing — Trait
traitDescription: It is a fabricated being, produced by hands, tools, formulae, rite, or inscription rather than by ordinary generation.
notes: Core identity trait for Constructs.

name: Bound to Purpose — Tag
notes: The being exists to perform a function, obey a command, or maintain a task.

name: Bound to Purpose — Trait
traitDescription: It is driven by command, inscription, design, or imprinted labor rather than by ordinary appetite, fear, kinship, or ambition.
notes: Core directive trait for Constructs.

name: Artificed Endurance — Tag
notes: The being endures strain in an unnatural, mechanical, or fabricated way.

name: Artificed Endurance — Trait
traitDescription: Its body bears force as crafted matter, stitched form, animated material, or reinforced shell rather than as ordinary flesh alone.
notes: Core durability trait for Constructs.

name: Grant: Obey the Imprint
notes: Grants the Obey the Imprint power.

name: Grant: Crafted Strike
notes: Grants the Crafted Strike power.

name: Grant: Tireless Function
notes: Grants the Tireless Function power.

name: Vast Bulk — Tag
notes: The being's sheer scale changes how it occupies space and threatens others.

name: Vast Bulk — Trait
traitDescription: Its body is so large that movement, presence, and simple force can break lines, crush obstacles, capsize vessels, or dominate ordinary creatures.
notes: Core scale trait for Colossi.

name: Hard to Bring Down — Tag
notes: The being is difficult to stop through ordinary force.

name: Hard to Bring Down — Trait
traitDescription: It can absorb punishment that would stop ordinary creatures, and lesser blows may matter more as irritation than injury unless they are well-placed, blessed, or desperate.
notes: Core endurance trait for Colossi.

name: Dormant Hunger — Tag
notes: The being's waking, feeding, or approach is driven more by immense appetite than by politics or doctrine.

name: Dormant Hunger — Trait
traitDescription: It spends long stretches in sleep, depth, lair, or half-waking stillness, but once stirred, starved, or roused, it moves with the terrible simplicity of a feeding catastrophe.
notes: Core motive trait for Colossi as great beasts rather than rulers.

name: Grant: Crushing Advance
notes: Grants the Crushing Advance power.

name: Grant: Titanic Blow
notes: Grants the Titanic Blow power.

name: Grant: Roar or Surge of Dread
notes: Grants the Roar or Surge of Dread power.

name: Badly Seen — Tag
notes: The being is difficult to perceive correctly or consistently.

name: Badly Seen — Trait
traitDescription: It is usually known through movement, traces, peripheral glimpses, or the certainty that something is there rather than through clear observation.
notes: Core perception-distortion trait for Zone creatures.

name: Zone Stalker — Tag
notes: The being hunts those moving through the Zone more reliably than they can track it.

name: Zone Stalker — Trait
traitDescription: It follows, circles, separates, and pressures intruders with patience, using the wrongness of the Zone as part of the hunt.
notes: Core pursuit trait for Zone creatures.

name: Alien Locality — Tag
notes: The being is shaped by a place where ordinary logic, memory, time, or perception has gone wrong.

name: Alien Locality — Trait
traitDescription: It belongs to warped terrain, wrong silence, broken paths, impossible nearness, and the hostile logic of the Zone rather than to any stable natural, supernatural, or historical order.
notes: Core ontological difference trait for Zone creatures as wrongly present beings.

name: Grant: Stalking Pressure
notes: Grants the Stalking Pressure power.

name: Grant: Lead From the Path
notes: Grants the Lead From the Path power.

name: Grant: Sudden Taking
notes: Grants the Sudden Taking power.

name: Impossible Bulk — Tag
notes: The being's scale is immense and physically scene-defining.

name: Impossible Bulk — Trait
traitDescription: Its body, or what passes for a body, is so vast that roads, ruins, treelines, and watchers must orient themselves around its movement.
notes: Core scale trait for Zone Colossi.

name: Zone Catastrophe — Tag
notes: The being is not just in the Zone but is itself a catastrophic expression of Zone wrongness.

name: Zone Catastrophe — Trait
traitDescription: It moves through warped land as a disaster of impossible nearness, altered scale, and hostile unreality rather than as a natural living creature.
notes: Core ontological trait for Zone Colossi.

name: Badly Understood — Tag
notes: Even at great size the being is difficult to perceive correctly.

name: Badly Understood — Trait
traitDescription: Even when enormous, it is known through partial views, wrong distances, vanished ground, and impossible signs more often than through a stable full sighting.
notes: Core perception-distortion trait for Zone Colossi.

name: Grant: Zonequake Advance
notes: Grants the Zonequake Advance power.

name: Grant: Colossal Taking
notes: Grants the Colossal Taking power.

name: Grant: Horizon of Dread
notes: Grants the Horizon of Dread power.

name: Mortal Person — Tag
notes: The being is an ordinary mortal person rather than a supernatural entity.

name: Mortal Person — Trait
traitDescription: This is a human being shaped by ordinary needs, loyalties, fear, training, and social position rather than by monstrous or supernatural nature.
notes: Core identity trait for People.

name: Holds a Place in the World — Tag
notes: The person belongs to a household, watch, levy, road, band, or local order.

name: Holds a Place in the World — Trait
traitName: Holds a Place in the World
traitDescription: The person is understandable in human terms: they answer to custom, fear, pay, hunger, faith, authority, kinship, and immediate danger.
notes: Core social-legibility trait for People.

name: Mortal Nerve — Tag
notes: However armed or trained, the person can still be shaken, routed, or overawed.

name: Mortal Nerve — Trait
traitDescription: The person can stand, panic, retreat, or break depending on pressure, leadership, injury, and what they believe they are facing.
notes: Core morale trait for People.

name: Grant: Press the Fight
notes: Grants the Press the Fight power.

name: Grant: Armed Strike
notes: Grants the Armed Strike power.

name: Grant: Fall Back or Hold
notes: Grants the Fall Back or Hold power.

name: Natural Weapons (Beast) — Trait
traitDescription: The body is itself the weapon: bite, claw, horn, tusk, or trampling shape, without dependence on crafted gear.

name: Heavy Body (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: A built frame braced for blunt force and slow irresistible pressure.

name: Heavy Body (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Corpse-mass and grave weight give the body unclean persistence and pulling force.

name: Heavy Body (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: Sheer catastrophic bulk that breaks lines, capsizes vessels, and crushes obstacles without armor or agility.

name: Armed (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Practical weapons, discipline, and ordinary human combat readiness.

name: Armed (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Burial-retained arms, battlefield remnants, and dead hands still knowing violence.

name: Armored (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Trained fighters, guarded vital points, more confidence under pressure.

name: Armored (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Armor that remained after death, heavy and uncanny in its persistence.

name: Armored (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Plated shell, reinforced joints, and difficult-to-breach artificed protection.

name: Mounted (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Horseman, raider, messenger, or knight with speed and shock advantage.

name: Mounted (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Impossible rider, hunt-rank, or sovereign mounted presence.

name: Ranged (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Bows, crossbows, stones, or thrown weapons handled by mortal skill.

name: Ranged (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Dart-projector, alchemical spitter, or made thing designed for distance attack.

name: Ranged (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Distance-force expressed through command, radiance, fire, or spiritual assault.

name: Swift Fragile (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Quick, elusive, half-seen, and hard to pin down.

name: Swift Fragile (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Small made thing, quick assistant, thin frame, and low staying power.

name: Swift Fragile (Construct) — MoveGround +1
notes: Spec also calls for Stamina -1; omitted here to keep one Stat Change per variant.

name: Swift Fragile (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Transformed quickness, predatory reflex, and unstable speed.

name: Grasping (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Dead hands, dragging grip, and refusal to let the living free.

name: Grasping (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Designed manipulator limbs, clamp-hands, and tool-like holding force.

name: Grasping (ZoneColossus) — Trait
traitDescription: Catastrophic grasp, crushing capture, and the horror of being taken by something too large to understand.

name: Guardian (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Defends grove, stream, homestead, or sacred patch. Warns before punishing.

name: Guardian (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Guard-post loyalty, watch duty, defense of charge or holding.

name: Guardian (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Imposed warding function, no fear of harm to itself.

name: Hunter (Beast) — Trait
traitDescription: Prey-driven, instinctive, and physical.

name: Hunter (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Sovereign pursuit, chosen quarry, and terrible inevitability.

name: Hunter (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: Patient stalking, isolation pressure, and sudden overtaking.

name: Lurer (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Misleads threats into water, bog, cold, roots, or getting lost.

name: Grant: Lead to the Bad Ground
Lurer (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: False rescue, wrong voice, impossible near-at-hand pull.

name: Lurer (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Seduction, testing, mockery, or dangerous invitation under elder custom.

name: Territorial (Beast) — Trait
traitDescription: Den, range, young, and feeding ground defense.

name: Territorial (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Place-bonded response to intrusion, damage, neglect, or desecration.

name: Territorial (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Old claim, parallel possession, offense at trespass into overlapping ground.

name: Vengeful (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Unfinished grievance, return for a wrong, selective punishment.

name: Vengeful (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Curse-driven retaliation against maker, betrayer, or target-class.

name: Grant: Strike the One Who Caused This

MmStrikeCause001.name: Strike the One Who Caused This

name: Vengeful (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Feud, blood-price, revenge, or social wrong pursued into violence.

name: Hungry (Beast) — Trait
traitDescription: Ordinary predation intensified by famine, season, or risk.

name: Hungry (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: Catastrophe-beast feeding drive, ship-breaking appetite, and disaster through need.

name: Hungry (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Life-force hunger, corpse-hunger, or warmth-hunger that overrides caution.

name: Protector of Kin (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Household, children, spouse, band, or retainers defended at personal cost.

name: Protector of Kin (Beast) — Trait
traitDescription: Young defense, mate defense, and den-rage.

name: High Drive When Pressed (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Mortal conviction hardens when kin, faith, oath, or honor is directly challenged. Increase Drive in social battles when the challenge touches the specific loyalty or duty named.
notes: Drive guidance only — no granted power per spec.

name: High Drive When Pressed (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: An unquiet dead thing becomes harder to turn aside when its grievance, grave, or unfinished purpose is named or obstructed. Increase Drive in social battles when opposed in the very matter that anchors its return.
notes: Drive guidance only — no granted power per spec.

name: High Drive When Pressed (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Outsider resolve intensifies when recruitment, command, doctrine, or factional purpose is resisted. Increase Drive in social battles when the target resists the outsider's central mission.
notes: Drive guidance only — no granted power per spec.

name: Recruiter (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Active pressure to win allegiance rather than merely kill or frighten.

name: Preserve the Hidden Order (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Civilizational preservation, magical continuity, and harsh judgment toward threats to the hidden order.

name: Grant: Command in the Name of the Old Order

MmCmdInOldOrd001.name: Command in the Name of the Old Order

name: Await the Summons (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Unnatural patience, dormancy, and sudden total obedience once triggered.

name: Return to the House (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Tragic repetition, domestic wrongness, and attachment to household identity after death.

name: Fulfill the Curse (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Inescapable compulsion, recurrence, and partial loss of choice under imposed magical fate.

name: Manifest the Zone (ZoneColossus) — Trait
traitDescription: Not predation alone, but active making-real of warped locality at immense scale.

name: Grant: Bring the Wrongness With It
Wood (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Elder parallel inhabitants of forest margins and hidden paths.

name: Wood (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Skogsra, dryads, wood-wives, grove spirits watchful through forest cover.

name: Wood (Beast) — Trait
traitName: At Home in Cover and Track
traitDescription: Natural, territorial, scent-driven, hard to corner in cover.

name: Water (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Brook-side and ford-dwelling hidden folk, quick to answer disrespect with magical reprisal.

name: Water (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: River wives, ford spirits, spring maidens — inviting and dangerous.

name: Water (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Water sovereigns, ford maidens of high rank, mist-and-depth rulers.

name: Water (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: Leviathans, kraken, immense sea-beasts whose presence turns water into catastrophe.

name: Hill (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Barrow folk, mound-dwellers, elder hidden communities of hill and hollow.

name: Hill (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Hill trolls, cliff-haunters, old stone slope wardens — heavy, enduring, territorial.

name: Hearth (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Hidden folk whose parallel habitation presses close against human hearth, hall, byre, and boundary.

name: Hearth (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Winter matrons, household judges, domestic sovereign powers.

name: Settlement (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitName: Of Yard, Lane, and Hidden Threshold
traitDescription: Hidden settlements, routes, and courts overlapping with roads, holdings, byres, lanes, and village edges.

name: Settlement (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Tomte-like beings, farmstead guardians, shrine spirits — protective, local, easily turned dangerous.

name: Settlement (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Villagers, guards, thieves, town watch, retainers — socially legible and locally bound.

name: Battlefield (People) — Trait
traitDescription: Soldiers, mercenaries, raiders, and disciplined armed opposition rooted in camp, march, and line of battle.

name: Battlefield (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Battle-dead, execution-dead, dead that return from slaughter fields and broken lines.

name: Deep Zone (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: Deep stalkers, manifestations, and predators of warped interiors where human sense has fully failed.

name: Deep Zone (ZoneColossus) — Trait
traitDescription: Immense manifestations moving through the deep Zone as if the land itself had become catastrophic anatomy.

name: Underground (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitName: Of Hall, Root, and Stone Below
traitDescription: Under-earth hidden folk, chamber-dwellers, tunnel-haunters keeping roads and halls below the human world.

name: Bog (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Mire spirits, marsh-lights, fen wardens, reed and rot beings.

name: Stone (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Standing-stone wardens, cave-mouth beings, cairn spirits, stone-bound trolls.

name: Mountain (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Highland spirits, avalanche wardens, summit presences — vast, cold, punishing through height and weather.

name: Corrupted (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Blighted guardians, spirits whose bond to place has become poisoned rather than severed.

name: Severed (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Uprooted, displaced, land-lost spirits no longer capable of healthy guardianship.

name: Grave (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Revenants, draugr, dead bound to mound, tomb, or churchyard.

name: Moon-Bound (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Werewolves, cyclical beast-transformations, night-ruled curse-beings.

name: Witch-Made (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Witch-made beasts, transformed toads, hares, or dogs, curse-creatures shaped by malediction or sympathetic craft.

name: Infernal (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Devils, contract-demons, tempters of hierarchy and corruption.

name: Angelic (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Cherubic war-servitors, seraphic messengers, rival faction powers of revelation, judgment, or terrible order.

name: Border Zone (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: Threshold stalkers, edge-haunters, wrong things that prey where the safe world thins.

name: Golem (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Clay guardians, laboring wards, letter-bound protectors, heavy obedient artifices.

name: Homunculus (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Alchemical servants, whispering assistants, hidden messengers, small artificial life-forms.

name: Brazen Head (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Warded oracle heads, speaking gate relics, learned magical watchers, doom-speaking artifices.

name: Wax Servitor (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Likeness-dolls made animate, witch-made helpers, hidden domestic spies, targeted malice-servitors.

name: Courtly (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Sidhe nobles, fairy kings and queens, barrow-court royalty, lords and ladies of the hollow hill.

name: Hunt (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Erlking, leaders of the Wild Hunt, spectral riders of rank — relentless, hard to flee once marked.

name: Smokeless Fire (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Jinn, ruin spirits of rank, beings of heat, smoke, bargain, and invisible fire.

name: Winter (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Winter queens, snow matrons, rulers of sleep, labor, and harsh blessing.

name: Half-Seen (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Glamour, parallel presence, and chosen visibility.

name: Half-Seen (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: Perception failure, uncertainty, and wrong glimpses.

name: Half-Seen (TheUnseen) — Trait
traitDescription: Impossible majesty not fully safe to perceive directly.

name: Easily Offended (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Insult, broken courtesy, and quick magical reprisal.

name: Easily Offended (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Trespass, neglect, and protective reaction to mistreatment.

name: Grant: Take Offense at the Harm
Voice Like a Lure (NatureSpirit) — Trait
traitDescription: Beckoning, beauty, and warning mistaken for invitation.

name: Voice Like a Lure (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: Wrong familiarity, false rescue, and bad following instinct.

name: Grant: Call from the Wrong Side
Smells the Living — Trait
traitDescription: Awareness of the warm, the breathing, the bleeding — instinctive in the beast, returning hunger in the dead.

name: Speaks in Bargains — Trait
traitDescription: Approach by trade — gift-for-gift old law for the elder, coercive infernal pact for the outsider; bound through promise.

name: Restless — Trait
traitDescription: Cannot settle, cannot lie still — the dead does not rest, the cursed cannot remain in one state.

name: Protective of Its Own — Trait
traitDescription: Defends pack, den, household, or kin with sudden explosive force.

name: Burned by Iron — Trait
traitDescription: Cold worked iron acts against the elder, hidden, or place-bound being — recoil, weakness, or check.

name: Must Be Invited (HiddenFolk) — Trait
traitDescription: Threshold custom, courtesy-law, and dangerous respect for boundaries.

name: Must Be Invited (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: Invitation as breach-permission for an outsider force that should not otherwise enter.

name: Must Be Invited (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Domestic haunting logic; return denied unless the house allows it.

name: Cannot Be Fully Seen (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: The zone-being can never be apprehended fully at once.

name: Wrong Reflection (Unnatural) — Trait
traitDescription: What returns in mirror or water is not what stands.

name: Only by Night (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: The beings force lives in darkness; it withdraws by day.

name: Bound to the Grave-Gift (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Tied to a buried item; loses force away from the gift.

name: Never Stops Watching (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: The construct does not sleep, blink, or look away.

name: Too Large for Shelter (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: Cannot fit inside ordinary buildings; breaks what it enters.

name: Strengthens in Moonlight (Cursed) — Trait
traitDescription: Visible increase in force, confidence, or wrongness under night.

name: Half-Seen Body (Zone) — Trait
traitDescription: The body itself refuses plain sight — witnesses see fragments, wrong angles, and a shape that does not assemble.

name: Impossible Bulk (ZoneColossus) — Trait
traitDescription: Sheer wrong scale — the body is more than the eye can fit at once, and mortals cannot count its parts together.

name: Tool-Body (Construct) — Trait
traitDescription: Limbs end in tools — blade, hook, hammer, or drill — rather than hands. The construct carries no separate weapon because it is the weapon.

name: Corpse-Body (Undead) — Trait
traitDescription: Openly a corpse — gaping wounds, slack jaw, exposed bone — yet still walking and still answering blows with more of the same.

name: Winged Horror (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: Vast wings carry the catastrophe aloft — shadow over villages, ruinous descent, and weather that turns at its passing.

name: Sleeps for Generations — Trait
traitDescription: Wakes once in a lifetime or once in an age — when it stirs, the land remembers it for a hundred years.

name: Hoards the Geography — Trait
traitDescription: Claims hill, river, valley, or shore as part of itself — its body and its territory cannot be reasoned apart.

name: Return to Old Sleep — Trait
traitDescription: Was woken against its will — wishes only to be left to lie down again. Will smash whatever keeps it awake.

name: Storm (Colossal) — Trait
traitDescription: The body is in the weather — its arrival is the storm, its passing is the calm, its anger is the lightning.

name: Heard Before Arrival — Trait
traitDescription: Horn, hoof, bell, or wind speaks of it before the eye finds it — by the time it is seen, the chase has begun.

name: Place Rather Than Body — Trait
traitDescription: Has no single body to strike — exists as terrain, weather, or host, distributed across the ground it claims.

name: Marks Witnesses Forever — Trait
traitDescription: Those who see it carry the seeing — wrong dreams, a changed name, a faint sign that other zone-things recognize.

name: Continue the Hunt — Trait
traitDescription: Drives the chase forward — the host cannot stop, will not stop, and chooses its prey from those who watched it pass.

name: Plague (ZoneColossus) — Trait
traitName: Of Pestilence and the Sick House
traitDescription: Moves as sickness moves — through breath, well-water, market, and the marked house — sparing some, taking others by no rule witnesses can name.
